definitions.explanation: A rich, deep shade of green. Used to describe the color of dense foliage, fabric, paint, and other objects with an intense green hue.

examples.japanese: {濃緑|のうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A deep green forest stretched out before us.
In summer, the leaves turn a deep green color.

examples.japanese: {濃緑|のうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐっていった。
examples.english: Students wearing dark green uniforms walked through the school gate.

notes:
Composed of {濃|のう} (dense/thick/dark) + {緑|りょく} (green). The on'yomi reading のうりょく is a homophone of ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability), so context is needed to distinguish them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃緑|のうりょく}{色|しょく}: dark green color
- {濃緑|のうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧: dark green leaves
- {濃緑|のうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧: deep green forest

RELATED COLOR WORDS:
- {深緑|しんりょく}/⟦{深緑|ふかみどり}→深緑：20363_fukamidori⟧: deep green — near-synonym; ⟦{深緑|ふかみどり}→深緑：20363_fukamidori⟧ is the native reading
- ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧: fresh green (of new leaves in spring) — bright and light, the opposite mood
- {淡緑|たんりょく}: light green; pale green — the opposite intensity
- ⟦{黄緑|きみどり}→黄緑：15605_kimidori⟧: yellow-green — lighter and warmer
